conclusions: Native input integration accounts for much of the difference in reporting API time, but disabling it moves UI update work into the follow-up phase. It is not a production optimization.

The update stage includes host ensure_updated and target lookup; finer core/host stage isolation remains necessary before attributing it to layout.
